745-2896-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter with an additional Spirit type as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters, it triggers, becoming an Aura and returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield with Necromancy attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

443-2511-2738-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-6012-6798--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-2366-5003-7893.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4029-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Benevolent Hydra
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-3209.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {4}{G}, creating three creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {2} and tapping three creature tokens, creating three creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two tapped creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
1270-2034-3209.notes: The starting cost can be reduced by tapping creatures to pay for Sprout Swarm using its convoke ability, and/or sacrificing those creatures to Ashnod's Altar.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-2762-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

457-1458-3836-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-3836-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Urza, Lord Protector
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-4478-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4478-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

413-650-891.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5078-6650-7356.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

2113-3525-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

338-5641-7173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-5641-7173.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5220-5686-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4871-5220-5686-5946.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

176-5147-6705.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-5147-6705.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1409-5421-5921.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve both Redcap Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-5663-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-2059.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1409-2895-3756-6763.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3756-6763.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-3000-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Squirrel and the Insect by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

147-3495-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3495-6797.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3495-6797.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2313-3693-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Conclave Mentor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
2313-3693-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

2034-2577-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

224-573-1359-1683.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-573-1359-1683.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Gruul Turf on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Gruul Turf from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

372-4142-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Hostage Taker.
372-4142-4200.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Hostage Taker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1257-2979-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Walking Atlas exiled by Patchwork Crawler.
1257-2979-4543.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Walking Atlas's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.

1824-2661-2932.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed nor are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
1824-2661-2932.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Acererak by paying {1}{B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Acererak enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2440-3705-4050-4758.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
2440-3705-4050-4758.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

251-1349-5256.notablePrerequisites: Denry Klin and another nontoken creature you control each have a coin counter on them.
251-1349-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrifiing another nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos' third ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Denry Klin triggers, putting a coin counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1339-1462-4206.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.Ever-Sheltering.
1339-1462-4206.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Ephara triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2713-2757-4499.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking Zirda.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Zirda, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

1636-2493-3443-3566-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1636-2493-3443-3566-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Archaeomancer, causing target player to mill cards equal to Archaeomancer's power.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Twilight's Call by paying {4}{B}{B}, causing each player to return all creature cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and each creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm that many times and Archaeomancer once.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, causing you to return Twilight's Call from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat step 10 until you have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
Repeat.

176-2034-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-2034-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

126-249-4406.notablePrerequisites: Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
126-249-4406.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, copying all cards you own in exile with kick counters on them and allowing you to cast the copies.
Cast the Chance for Glory copy by paying {1}{W}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the end of the extra turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Chance for Glory triggers.
Holding priority, activate Obeka by tapping it, causing you to end your turn and exile Chance for Glory's trigger from the stack.
Repeat each turn.

292-1495-2313.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-2313.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

3149-3981.notablePrerequisites:
Worldslayer attached to Avacyn.
An opponent is unable to block Avacyn.
Avacyn does not have summoning sickness.
3149-3981.description:
Attack the player unable to block Avacyn.
Worldslayer triggers on combat damage, destroying all permanents your opponent control.
Repeat each turn to prevent your opponent from accumulating permanents.

1835-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Zaxara.
Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1835-3525.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Zaxara.
Repeat.

224-433-3861.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
